title: Kenyan Crumble Delight
description: A flavorful Kenyan-inspired dish made with a crumble topping and a side of rice.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat some oil and sauté the lively vegetables until tender.
Add the Kenyan spice blend to the pan and stir.
In a separate bowl, mix the crumble with a bit of water until crumbly.
Transfer the cooked rice to a baking dish and top with the vegetable mixture.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until the crumble is golden brown.
